newsitem.title: UK: UK's Allied Domecq forms venture in India.
newsitem.headline: UK's Allied Domecq forms venture in India.

text.p: British drinks group Allied Domecq Plc said on Tuesday it had formed a joint venture with Indian company Clan Morgan & Co to build a plant in India to bottle Teacher's Whisky.
Allied said the new company, Allied Domecq Spirits & Wine (India) Ltd, will build a 3.5 million stg plant in the western state of Rajasthan.
Teachers is a leading brand with a 35 percent market share in the 70,000-case Scotch whisky market in India.
The new company will start trading in August and will initially employ 200 people, the company said.
Allied entered the Indian market in September 1994 through a partnership with Jagatjit Industries which has not come to an end.
An Allied official told Reuters the UK firm had taken a 50 percent stake in the new venture.
Clan Morgan is a Delhi-based firm with diversified interests.
